issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — visual editor injects x-* spans inside <option> children. Cosmetic, no functional break, likely from a dev-only overlay. Consider suppressing the visual-editor wrapper on <option> children.
Pre-existing wss:///api/ws 403 handshake errors persist (carried from earlier iterations, unrelated to iter-112).
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning still present on cold nav (carried).

critical_code_review_comments: vps_deployments.advance_deployment for simulated provider computes state purely from wall-clock elapsed since created_at — restarting the backend within 28s of a REQUESTED simulated deployment can jump the state machine multiple steps in one GET (crossed[] captures every step so state_history is correct, but clients only see the final state). Fine for a demo/simulated provider; document this so ops don't mistake the behaviour for a bug on real providers.

infra_routes.create_pairing catches bare Exception and always returns 400. Malformed ObjectId returns 400 which is right, but a genuine ValueError('account not found') from vps_agent.create_pairing_code should ideally be 404. Minor.
infra_routes.py line 3 imports statistics but never uses it (dead import).
Unused imports and no-Content-Type checks on agent endpoints are fine given the JSON body is optional and .get()'s handle it, but consider validating Content-Type=application/json for safer parsing.
vps_deployments.recommend_capacity accepts negative mt5_instances silently (max(1, n)) — worth surfacing a 400 if the client sends 0/negative rather than transparently clamping.

The 'existing_vps' path automatically issues a bootstrap token via create_deployment_ep — if the client also passes issue_bootstrap:true and this becomes idempotent (retry), a second bootstrap token is minted every POST retry even though the deployment is the same. Consider gating the token issuance behind 'new deployment created' (dep created_at == now).
Bootstrap installer endpoint returns 401 on invalid tokens but writes no audit_log entry. For a security-sensitive one-time-token flow, add an audit_log write on both success and failure attempts.
